Select: molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, canonical_smiles. Source: molecule_dictionary, docs, compound_records, compound_structures. Join: docs.doc_id = compound_records.doc_id; compound_records.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno; molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Filter: docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1122107'. Sort: molecule_chembl_id ascending.
